c4-tide-write-rules: Read where the catches should go. Then build a rule with the blocks. Run tests every catch on the belt, one at a time. If your rule sends one the wrong way, the belt stops there, so you can change a block and run again.
c4-tide-find-rules: Every catch on this belt is already sorted. Look at what the catches in each bucket share. Build a rule that sorts every catch the same way, then run it.
c4-tide-trace-rules: The gate starts on one side. A catch that matches the rule flips the gate as it arrives, and the gate stays that way until the next flip. Send each catch where the gate points, then check.
c4-tide-bell: The bell can ring on this catch, or on the catch before it. Watch which catch the bell changes.
c4-tide-not: Not means a catch must not have that clue. No bell means a catch without a bell.
